request.caption: Late-night chill R&B slow jam, neo-soul ballad, sparse minimal drums with soft deep 808 kick and warm sub bass, gentle finger snaps, warm Rhodes electric piano with lush maj7 and m7 chords, airy ambient pads, intimate breathy male lead vocal with soft falsetto in the chorus, clear English diction, lush reverb, spacious dreamy mix, night flight above the clouds, melancholic but hopeful, emotional build into the final chorus

lines.en: Midnight on the runway, lights strung in a line
lines.zh: 午夜的跑道 灯火连成一条线

lines.en: I counted every distance, every second, every sign
lines.zh: 我数过每一段距离 每一秒 每一个信号

lines.en: I used to think the sky was just a farther kind of ground
lines.zh: 我曾以为 天空不过是更远的地面

lines.en: If I ran a little faster, I could outrun the sound
lines.zh: 只要再快一点 就能跑赢声音

lines.en: Throttle up, I'm swallowed by the grey
lines.zh: 推满油门 灰色的云将我吞没

lines.en: When I can't see a thing, I trust what the instruments say
lines.zh: 什么都看不清的时候 我只信仪表

lines.en: Up above the clouds, every answer's light
lines.zh: 云层之上 每个答案都很轻

lines.en: I could pick them like the stars out of the endless night
lines.zh: 我能像摘星一样 从长夜里把它们摘下

lines.en: But so many answers never touched the ground
lines.zh: 可是太多答案 从未触到地面

lines.en: Nothing's ever true until it lands
lines.zh: 没有落地 就不算真的

lines.en: Holding pattern, I keep drawing circles in the air
lines.zh: 盘旋等待 我在空中一圈圈画着航线

lines.en: Wrote an answer for each storm before the storm was there
lines.zh: 风暴还没来 我已为每一场写好回答

lines.en: But the wind won't read a single map I made
lines.zh: 可风 从不读我画的任何一张地图

lines.en: It only asks me if I dare to come down
lines.zh: 它只问我 敢不敢降落

lines.en: Up above the clouds, every answer's light
lines.zh: 云层之上 每个答案都很轻

lines.en: I could pick them like the stars out of the endless night
lines.zh: 我能像摘星一样 从长夜里把它们摘下

lines.en: But so many answers never touched the ground
lines.zh: 可是太多答案 从未触到地面

lines.en: Nothing's ever true until it lands
lines.zh: 没有落地 就不算真的

lines.en: Let the river be a river
lines.zh: 让河流 做河流

lines.en: Let the stone remain a stone
lines.zh: 让石头 仍是石头

lines.en: Give the wings back to the sky
lines.zh: 把翅膀 还给天空

lines.en: Give the weight back to the ground
lines.zh: 把重量 还给大地

lines.en: Gear down, and the clouds start to part
lines.zh: 放下起落架 云层开始分开

lines.en: Every shake is not a fall, it's the earth's beating heart
lines.zh: 每一次颠簸都不是坠落 是大地的心跳

lines.en: Down below the clouds, every light is heavy
lines.zh: 云层之下 每一盏灯都很重

lines.en: Every one's a promise that I swore I'd keep
lines.zh: 每一盏 都是我许下要兑现的承诺

lines.en: Flying was only half of it
lines.zh: 飞行 只是一半

lines.en: Landing is the other half
lines.zh: 落地 是另一半

lines.en: Nothing's ever true until it lands
lines.zh: 没有落地 就不算真的

lines.en: The runway lights line up again
lines.zh: 跑道的灯 又连成了线

lines.en: This time I'm on the ground
lines.zh: 这一次 我站在地上

lines.en: Still looking up
lines.zh: 依然抬头望天
